name: ChainShield
description: Blockchain-backed phishing and smishing URL detection by ChainShield.
_comment_host_permissions: The extension calls the FastAPI backend directly via fetch().
For local development the backend runs at http://127.0.0.1:8000.
If you deploy the backend, replace this with your production URL.
Broad permissions like <all_urls> or tabs are NOT requested.
The extension does NOT access page content — it only calls the API.
